place: Garh Goshain near Rampur Kheri, Kandhla
what: Langir Goshain, Mahant of Garh Goshain (a fort), blamed as chief instigator of the 'Azimgirdi' rising; fort stormed by Col. Burn and the Mahant hanged on the spot
